PathRef.description:
A path as C2 ids: `edge_ids[i]` joins `node_ids[i]` and `node_ids[i + 1]`. The effective
share range is the product of the OWNS share bands along an ownership path (PHASE-2.md 5.3);
each bound's flag says whether it is open ("more than", "less than") or closed ("at least",
"at most"), and is null exactly when the bound is.

effective_share_max.description: The product of the upper share bounds (each / 100) along the path, times 100, rounded to 4 decimals; null when a relationship has no upper bound. An effective share is NeonRadar's calculation from the published bands, not a figure any register records, and not the result of a sanctions ownership test.
effective_share_max.title: Effective Share Max

effective_share_max_exclusive.description: True when any relationship's upper bound is exclusive (say "less than"), false when all are inclusive (say "at most"); null when effective_share_max is null. An effective share is NeonRadar's calculation from the published bands, not a figure any register records, and not the result of a sanctions ownership test.
effective_share_max_exclusive.title: Effective Share Max Exclusive

effective_share_min.description: The product of the lower share bounds (each / 100) along the path, times 100, rounded to 4 decimals; null when a relationship has no lower bound. An effective share is NeonRadar's calculation from the published bands, not a figure any register records, and not the result of a sanctions ownership test.
effective_share_min.title: Effective Share Min

effective_share_min_exclusive.description: True when any relationship's lower bound is exclusive (say "more than"), false when all are inclusive (say "at least"); null when effective_share_min is null. An effective share is NeonRadar's calculation from the published bands, not a figure any register records, and not the result of a sanctions ownership test.
effective_share_min_exclusive.title: Effective Share Min Exclusive

PathRef.title: PathRef

get.description: Chains of `OWNS` relationships that end at the entity (`up`: its owners, their owners, and so on) or start at it (`down`). `entity_id` is a canonical id or any id in its `referents`; an unknown id answers a 404 problem. Paths have 1 to `max_hops` relationships and never repeat a node. Every path's `node_ids` start at the entity (`root_id`), so for `up` they run from the entity to its top recorded owner and for `down` from the entity to its furthest holding. A path's `effective_share_min` and `effective_share_max` are the products of `share_pct_min / 100` and `share_pct_max / 100` over its relationships, times 100, rounded to 4 decimals, and null when any relationship lacks that bound; a bound is exclusive when any relationship's bound is. An effective share is NeonRadar's calculation from the published bands, not a figure any register records, and not the result of a sanctions ownership test. At most 200 paths, ordered by `effective_share_max` descending (nulls last), then by length, then by the list `node_ids` as returned (root first); `subgraph` holds their nodes and relationships, at most 500 nodes, and `truncated` is set when either limit cut something. Only `OWNS` is traversed: `CONTROLS` and `CONSOLIDATES` are reachable through `/paths` and `/network`. Runs read-only with a 5-second transaction timeout; a query that times out answers a 503 problem whose detail suggests a smaller `max_hops` or fewer relationship types.

parameters.description: `up`: chains that end at the entity; `down`: chains that start at it.
parameters.name: direction

schema.description: `up`: chains that end at the entity; `down`: chains that start at it.
schema.title: Direction

parameters.description: Absent or 0 keeps every path. Above 0, keeps the paths whose effective share can reach it: `effective_share_max` above `min_share`, or equal to it with a closed upper bound, compared after rounding. Paths whose maximum is unknown are dropped.
parameters.name: min_share

schema.description: Absent or 0 keeps every path. Above 0, keeps the paths whose effective share can reach it: `effective_share_max` above `min_share`, or equal to it with a closed upper bound, compared after rounding. Paths whose maximum is unknown are dropped.
schema.title: Min Share

get.description: The source records an entity was built from, how each joined it, and the other entities it may describe (possible matches, never confirmed and never merged). `entity_id` is a canonical id or any id in its `referents`; an unknown id answers a 404 problem. A single-record entity has one member with method `identity`. `PossibleMatch.match_probability` is null for `deterministic` and `source_hint` possible matches, and `rule` names the D rule of a `deterministic` one; every possible-match explanation says "not confirmed". At most 50 possible matches, the highest match probability first, then those without a probability, by entity id.
Neo4j connectivity and versions; always 200, `degraded` unless Neo4j, APOC and GDS answer.
Versions, datasets with licences and counts, disclaimers and graph counts.

Up to 5 shortest paths between `from_id` and `to_id`, ignoring direction, with 1 to `max_hops` relationships of the types in `rel_types`. Each id is a canonical id or any id in its `referents`; an unknown id answers a 404 problem. Effective shares and their two flags are set only for a path made entirely of `OWNS` relationships that all point the same way along it; otherwise all four are null. An effective share is NeonRadar's calculation from the published bands, not a figure any register records, and not the result of a sanctions ownership test. Runs read-only with a 5-second transaction timeout; a query that times out answers a 503 problem whose detail suggests a smaller `max_hops` or fewer relationship types.

parameters.description: Repeatable. HAS_ADDRESS, LINKED_TO and POSSIBLY_SAME_AS are used only when asked for; FLAGS, PRODUCED and RESOLVED_TO are never allowed (422).
